paper_watch.py bug: yfinance history() without prepost returned PRIOR-session bars pre-market -> spurious EXIT-RESTING-STOP on TWLO at 210.44 (-$1,995) while the stock was at 232. Rejected, root-caused, fixed with prepost=True + a today-only date guard. First live exercise of this code path in the program.
yfinance removed from the live path by directive after the phantom TWLO stop; paper_watch now consumes agent-supplied RH bars only.

L2 veto on NRXP is structural, not incidental: NRXP's spread (3.56x3.73 = 4.6%) exceeds the stop-limit's 0.5% cap, so the order can trigger but never fill. This is the 'failed fill' case S100-S104 left unmeasured, and it blocked the day's best-gated name 3x while 137,776 sh traded.

paper_watch.py bug #2: single shared position.json corrupts state with 2+ concurrent positions (losing `scaled` would double-bank a scale-out). Fixed to per-symbol position_{SYM}.json. Surfaced the moment the book first held two names.
halal_check can return PASS from all-zero fundamentals (SSP). A pass built on absent data must be treated as unevaluable, not permissible.

paper_watch.py bug #3: peak tracked only the newest bar, so highs in bars that appeared between ticks were never counted (NRXP hit 4.1497, stored peak 3.98). Understated peak weakens the trailing stop. Fixed to max over all bars in the file.
Three names today (SSP, RMCO, GTN) returned halal PASS from all-zero fundamentals. halal_check cannot currently distinguish 'verified permissible' from 'no data' - a real tooling gap.

paper_watch.py bug #4: resting-stop and trail exits were evaluated only against the newest bar, so batched bars skipped the checks entirely - a dip-and-recover would be missed and the paper record flattered. Fixed to replay every unseen bar. NRXP's lowest close 3.7350 vs trail 3.73473 - survived by 0.0003.
NRXP's real trail exit fired 10:30 ET but was detected at 11:50 - the newest-bar-only bug hid it for 80 minutes, during which the log wrongly reported the position as open.
A naive per-bar replay that uses CURRENT pressure on PAST bars invents exits (booked a phantom -$101 on NRXP). Pressure and peak must both be reconstructed as of each bar.
rvol_rule: time-of-day-adjusted: today cum vol to clock T / mean cum vol to same T over last ~20 sessions; log naive full-day too; never permanently reject on an uncomputable ratio
